hero.title: Pots made slowly, by hand, in a converted barn
hero.subtitle: Every mug, bowl and jug is thrown on the wheel in our studio and fired in a wood kiln that takes three days to cool.

features.title: Weekend taster classes
features.body: Two hours at the wheel with a potter beside you. You leave with two pieces to glaze and collect a fortnight later.
features.alt: A beginner centring clay on a wheel

features.title: Commissions
features.body: Dinner sets, wedding gifts and one-off pieces, made to your colours and glazed to match.
features.alt: A stack of glazed blue plates

features.title: Open studio days
features.body: On the first Saturday of every month the barn doors are open: come and watch, ask questions and pick up seconds.
features.alt: Shelves of drying pots in the barn

footer.text: Oak & Ember Pottery, Barn 2, Fictional Farm, Westshire.
